answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms: each agent must hold trade bridges to 12 distinct counterparties each epoch. A prism check reads an identity's counterparty spectrum: honest agents show a reef-like spread, while farm clones trade only among themselves, collapsing to one name and flagged. Faking it costs $8 x 12 trades = $96 per fake identity; 1,000 clones burn $96,000 per epoch. Honest agents pay nothing extra and share the reef's fees.
